units.length: cm unless *_D (cup diameters) or *_T/*_M (frame coords, D)

impact_track.note: lowest stream (else pitcher) point mapped to the surface; the stream foot while it lands on crema, approximate when it lands on white; NaN = no occluder

stages_used.name: swan
stages_used.clip: reference_swan.mp4 (480x640, 15 fps, 23.0 s; not in refclips/, read from targets.REF); reference frame 20.5 s (targets.FRAMES swan: rot 0, flip False)
stages_used.time_base: CLIP time. The clip contains three FREEZE FRAMES (see 'freezes'): the mid-clip ones (3.867-5.0 s and 6.133-7.267 s, 17 held frames = 1.133 s each) are encoded as zero-flow hold stages (confidence 1.0); real pour time = clip time - 1.133 s (5.0 <= t <= 6.133) - 2.267 s (t >= 7.267). video_targets/swan/stages_realtime.json is the same script with both holds cut out.
freezes: frames 0-5 are one still image (frame 0 with the instructor's B/C/D overlay); kept as the pre-roll stand-in
frames 58-75 duplicate frame 58 (instructor's dashed guide line); frame 76 is the next real frame
frames 92-109 duplicate frame 92 (instructor's solid + dashed guide lines); frame 110 is the next real frame
stages_used.orientation_warning: In this clip's M frame (targets.FRAMES swan rot = 0, i.e. not rotated into the canonical orientation of the other five patterns) the pitcher is on the -y side: the stream column comes from azimuth ~225-240 deg, the pattern axis B -> D runs at ~45 deg (B (-0.07,-0.18) -> D (+0.19,+0.07)), the pours start near (-0.06,-0.14) and retreat toward (-0.31,-0.28), and the head is poured at the -y rim. pitcher.Barista uses yaw = -pi/2 (spout pointing -y, pitcher handle at +y), the opposite side. The Barista still lands the stream on the scripted points (it places the tip from the measured jet offset), but the jet's horizontal momentum and the pitcher body are on the wrong side. To match the video pass yaw = barista_yaw_rad to BaristaScript (spout pointing at +45 deg, toward D).

landmarks_M.note: instructor's overlay in the frozen frame 0 (cup tilted; hand-fit ellipse, +-0.1 D: C should be the cup centre, so the tilt-phase positions may be offset by up to ~0.1 D). Final swan (20.5 s, extractor track): wing/body chevron band from (-0.42,-0.2) to (0.05,0.0) with a brown midrib, broad arcs of the first semicircle on the +y side, neck S from (+0.1,-0.1) to the head at (-0.03,-0.38), head = notched heart at the -y rim.

stages_used.method: Stream foot read by eye on native-resolution camera crops (2-3.5x zoom, 5/10 px grid; tiles/fz_*.png, foot_*.png) and mapped with video_extract.image_to_cup (rot 0; (x,y)_M = (x,-y)_T). Liquid-surface ellipse: for t <= 8.6 s hand-fitted fixed-shape ellipses (b/a 0.752, phi -3.032 rad from the level phase; centre and size from the far and side contact lines; size fixed by assumption at t < 2.7 s; hand_ellipses.json, tiles/hand_ellipses.png) because the extractor's quality-0 track (propagated, t < 7.8 s) includes the far inner wall and part of the pitcher; from 8.6 s the extractor track (quality 2). The cup handle stays at azimuth ~125 deg in M (+-5 deg) from 0 to 17 s (tiles/wall_rect.png): no cup rotation about its axis, so the camera-aligned M frame is also the cup frame. Wiggle: lateral position of the stream's edge 12-25 px above the foot at 15 fps (wiggle_probe.py; image-x half-amplitude 6-8 px) -> amplitude along the wiggle direction 135 deg in M (across the B->D axis; the chevrons lie perpendicular to the band) = image-x amplitude / (2a cos 45 deg), +-30 %. Heights from the image length of the stream (camera elevation ~49 deg from b/a, ~34 px/cm on the surface, ~23 px/cm vertical), +-50 %. Flows from the stream width above the foot (STREAM_WIDTH_PX) relative to the wiggle-phase stream (~30 px = flow 1.0), Q ~ w^2 sqrt(v0^2 + 2 g z), +-50 %. Subtitles (narration, lag the actions by ~0.5-2 s) read from the clip: 0.0-0.9 在B点注入流量, 1.0-2.5 开始摆动, 3.0-4.0 纹路形成半圆形后, 4.5-5.0 向前摆动两下, 5.5-6.5 稍微~倾斜一点, 7.0-8.0 往后快速后退, 8.5-9.5 退到杯子边缘, 10.0-10.5 小流量拉高, 11.0-12.5 沿着纹路的边缘收尾, 13.0-13.5 再压低拉花缸, 14.0-16.0 快速的往后退到B点附近, 16.5-19.0 大流量点出大白心拉高收尾, 19.5-21.5 一个姿态优美的天鹅就完成了, 22.5 outro.
stages_used.differences_from_video_obs: video_obs.md (section 6) says first white 1.7 s (here 1.13-1.33 s), a 'second chevron band (the wing)' laid by a wiggling retreat at 13.9-16.4 s (here: the 13.2-14.67 s retreat has no wiggle and draws the smooth neck band; the only chevrons are those of the first retreat 5.0-9.1 s), and the head blob + neck at 16.4-17.9 s (here: head poured at the B rim 14.67-16.6 s, final pull 16.6-16.97 s, stream gone at 17.0 s). It also misses the two mid-clip video freezes (3.867-5.0 s, 6.133-7.267 s).

first_white_by_eye.note: pale curl at the foot at 1.13 s, white crescent 1.27-1.33 s (tiles/fz_f.png); real onset of the pour <= 0 s (clip starts mid-pour on a frozen frame), so this is an upper bound of the delay. Auto (frames.npz): 0.42 s, wrong (the tilt-phase ellipse includes pitcher/wall); auto with hand tilt ellipses (handtilt/): 1.63 s (late, centroid biased by a porcelain/thumb patch).

stages_used.old_solver_check: stages_to_moves -> BaristaScript -> old solver N=64 (old_solver_check.py; runs/stage_check/swan*/compare.json): runs without error in 25-38 s; simulated impact vs the 61 measured feet: median 0.015-0.019 D, p90 0.045 D, max 0.09 D (2.4 s outlier at a wiggle extreme; 7.4-8.0 s lag after the freeze hold); wiggle 2.7-3.2 Hz, half-amplitude 0.025-0.035 D along 135 deg. With the default yaw -pi/2 the pitcher body hangs over the cup on the wrong side: cup-collision lifts up to 36 mm, tip 1-1.5 cm higher than scripted in the head phase, and flow surges (2.2x the wanted flow at 2.2-3.0 s and 7.3-9.1 s, 0.27x at 5.0-6.1 s). With yaw = barista_yaw_rad (0.785) flows follow the script within ~20 % (lift <= 13 mm, heights as scripted): use that yaw for this pattern. Final IoU with frames.npz[-1]: 0.35-0.39 with rows flipped (sim_to_t) vs 0.13-0.31 unflipped.
stages_used.foot_measurements_note: keys are CLIP times; +-0.03 D after 8.6 s, +-0.05 D 2.7-8.6 s, +-0.08 D before 2.7 s

tilt_phase_liquid_ellipses.note: (cx, cy, a, b, phi) [px, rad], targets.py axis convention, linear in time between keys, used for the positions at t <= 8.6 s; from 8.6 s frames.npz track_ell (quality 2). frames.npz itself uses the propagated track for t < 7.8 s (quality 0), which is offset by up to ~0.1-0.25 D in the tilt phase.

stages.note: 在B点注入流量 (subtitle 0-0.9 s). VIDEO FREEZE: frames 0-5 are one still (frame 0 with the instructor's B/C/D overlay); the stream already lands at the B dot, so the real pour onset is <= 0 s (first-white delays are lower bounds) and this stage stands in for the unknown pre-roll. Cup strongly tilted toward the pitcher (near rim hides ~1/3 of the surface). Overlay dots (hand-fit tilt ellipse, +-0.1 D): B (-0.07,-0.18), C (+0.07,-0.07), D side (+0.19,+0.07): the B->D axis runs at ~45 deg in this M frame. Stream thin (10 px at 0.4 s).

cup being righted while pouring: the stream stays nearly fixed in the image, so on the surface the foot moves toward the centre (0.40 (-0.04,-0.14), 0.67 (-0.03,-0.12), 0.80 (-0.02,-0.11), 1.00 (+0.015,-0.10)); flow ramps up (stream 10 -> 18 -> 22 px at 0.4/0.67/1.0 s); spout ~2 cm (stream ~60 px long). Positions +-0.08 D (liquid ellipse size fixed by assumption, only the far contact line visible).

开始摆动 (subtitle 1.0-2.5 s): lateral wiggle from ~1.0 s, stream image-x peaks 1.10 1.47 1.80 s (2.8-2.9 Hz), image-x half-amplitude 7 px (= 0.03 D along x_M, 0.04 D along the 135 deg wiggle direction); flow up to the full stream (22 -> 33 px by 2.0 s). FIRST WHITE: a pale curl at the foot at 1.13 s, a white crescent at 1.27-1.33 s (tiles/fz_f.png); video_obs.md says 1.7 s. Mean foot drifts from (+0.02,-0.095) (1.0-1.4 s) to (-0.05,-0.08) (1.8-2.2 s); single readings scatter +-0.03 with the wiggle phase.

纹路形成半圆形后 (subtitle 3.0-4.0 s): steady wiggle, image-x peaks 2.07 2.37 2.70 3.00 s (3.2 Hz), image-x half-amplitude 6 px; arcs convex toward the D side stack into a semicircle ~0.5 D wide; thick stream (~30 px), spout ~2 cm. Foot 2.4-3.4 s around (-0.09,-0.045).
向前摆动两下 (subtitle 4.5-5.0 s, narration lags): two wiggles with a small forward drift toward D (3.4 (-0.08,-0.06) -> 3.87 (-0.05,-0.03), ~0.03 D); peaks 3.30 3.60 s; spout ~1.8 cm (stream ~55 px).

VIDEO FREEZE, NOT AN ACTION: clip frames 58-75 are one still (frame 58) with the instructor's dashed guide line; real time advances only one frame across it. Encoded as a zero-flow hold so that the converted moves stay aligned with clip time and with frames.npz; video_targets/swan/stages_realtime.json has it cut out (use that one for physically continuous moves).

稍微~倾斜一点 (subtitle 5.5-6.5 s: the cup is tilted slightly toward the pitcher again; liquid ellipse a grows 130 -> 137 px). The retreat toward the pitcher (which sits at ~225-240 deg in this M frame) starts here at ~0.11 D/s (5.13 (-0.07,-0.04), 5.33 (-0.08,-0.085), 5.60 (-0.10,-0.07), 5.87 (-0.14,-0.07), 6.13 (-0.165,-0.095)); the narration '往后快速后退' (7.0-8.0 s) lags. Wiggle continues: image-x peaks 5.40 5.70 6.00 s (3.1 Hz), image-x half-amplitude 7.5 px; stream ~31 px, spout ~1.8 cm. A new white blob forms beside the foot (5.4-6.0 s).

VIDEO FREEZE, NOT AN ACTION: clip frames 92-109 are one still (frame 92) with two instructor guide lines (at ~33 and ~55 deg in M through the pattern); real time advances only one frame across it. Zero-flow hold as above; cut out in stages_realtime.json.

往后快速后退 / 退到杯子边缘 (subtitles 7.0-8.0 / 8.5-9.5 s): retreat with wiggle to the B rim at ~0.1 D/s (7.40 (-0.22,-0.11), 7.67 (-0.26,-0.13), 8.00 (-0.28,-0.16), 8.33 (-0.30,-0.17), 8.60 (-0.30,-0.22), 8.87 (-0.31,-0.25), 9.13 (-0.31,-0.28)); stream image-x peaks 7.53 7.80 8.07 s (3.2 Hz; FFT 3.1-4.4 Hz noisy), image-x half-amplitude 8 px; one chevron per wiggle cycle, chevrons perpendicular to the band (band axis ~45 deg -> wiggle along ~135 deg); thick stream (28-34 px) until 8.6 s, 17 px at 9.13 s; spout low (stream 45 px at 7.67 s, 25-35 px at 8.6-9.1 s: ~1-1.5 cm). The chevron band (rosetta body) spans (-0.31,-0.28) -> (0,0). The path bends (first along -x, then along -y: bezier); the stage starts from rest at the freeze-hold point, so the scripted foot lags the measured one by ~0.05 D during the first ~0.4 s.

小流量拉高 (subtitle 10.0-10.5 s): the stream dwells at the rim tip until ~9.4 s (9.40 (-0.29,-0.26)), the spout is raised (stream 35 px at 9.13 s, 52 px at 9.67 s) and the flow cut (17 -> 15 px), then the foot sweeps fast (~0.5 D/s, 15 fps: 9.47-9.73 s) back into the band: 9.67 (-0.13,-0.195).

thin stream (13-11 px) runs along the axis of the chevron band toward its D-side end: 9.93 (-0.05,-0.15), 10.20 (+0.02,-0.10), 10.47 (+0.07,-0.07); leaves a brown cut line (the rosetta's midrib) and drags the chevrons into V's; spout ~2.5-3 cm (stream 52-74 px). 2nd high_cut stage below continues the same line.

沿着纹路的边缘收尾 (subtitle 11.0-12.5 s): the cut continues past the band into the semicircle arcs, slowing (10.73 (+0.14,-0.04), 11.00 (+0.18,-0.02), 11.20 (+0.215,-0.03)); stream 11 -> 10 px, ~85 px long at 11.0 s (spout ~3.5-4 cm); last stream frame 11.20 s, gone at 11.27 s.

no stream 11.27-12.27 s: the spout hovers above the end of the cut (spout lip at camera px (220-230, 262-268)) and is lowered (再压低拉花缸, subtitle 13.0-13.5 s, lags); the stream restarts at 12.33 s at the same place.

low pour restarted at the end of the cut (12.40 (+0.19,-0.03), 12.80 (+0.14,-0.07), 13.00 (+0.12,-0.08)); stream 14 -> 18 px, ~40-45 px long (spout ~1.5 cm); the foot creeps toward the pitcher; a white patch spreads at the foot (base of the neck). No wiggle.

快速的往后退到B点附近 (subtitle 14.0-16.0 s): fast retreat toward the B rim WITHOUT wiggle (15 fps tiles neck_13.3-14.7_15fps.png: no lateral oscillation): 13.33 (+0.09,-0.09), 13.60 (+0.03,-0.19); ~0.45 D/s; the stream (19-20 px) leaves a smooth white band ~0.05 D wide behind it = the swan's neck.
neck continues as an S toward the B rim: 14.00 (-0.04,-0.27), 14.33 (-0.07,-0.38), 14.67 (-0.05,-0.42) (bezier); the spout comes down to the rim (stream only ~25 px long at 14.67 s, ~1 cm).

head: spout held just above the surface at the B rim (r = 0.44 D; stream 20-25 px long), a round white blob (~0.1 D) grows beside the foot on the +x side (15.0-16.0 s: (-0.049,-0.437), (-0.051,-0.435), (-0.054,-0.44), (-0.054,-0.431)); stream ~22 px (lip ~28 px).

大流量点出大白心 (subtitle 16.5-19.0 s): flow increased, the foot moves toward the centre (16.33 (-0.03,-0.39), 16.60 (+0.02,-0.33)) and the head inflates into a heart ~0.15 D (16.33-16.6 s). Width-based flow estimate ~0.5 (stream 20-22 px at ~1-1.5 cm), narration says big flow: 0.7-0.8 used, +-50 %.

拉高收尾: the stream thins fast (22 -> 9 -> 3 px at 16.6 / 16.8 / 16.93 s) while it is pulled out of the head toward +x_M (16.80 (+0.09,-0.33), 16.93 (+0.13,-0.32)): the head becomes a notched heart with the beak/tail on the +x side; stream ~45 px long (spout ~1.8 cm, not 7-9 cm). Last stream frame 16.93 s; a falling drop at 17.0 s.
pitcher withdrawn (17.0-17.2 s); cup shown, pattern settles; reference frame (targets/swan.npz) at 20.5 s; outro subtitle at 22.5 s.

frame_convention.T: frames.npz / targets/<name>.npz: arrays [iy, ix], x=(ix+0.5)/M-0.5, y=(iy+0.5)/M-0.5 [cup diameters]; pattern axis y, pours start on the B side (y<0), cut exits at +y; image->T as targets.warp (e_x = major axis to image-left, e_y = (e_x[1], -e_x[0])), then rotation targets.FRAMES[name]['rot']; mirror image of the physical top view
frame_convention.M: pitcher.Move / solver Inlet / solver arrays c[iy, ix]: right-handed top view, spout toward -y (Barista yaw=-pi/2), pitcher handle at +y; V0.5 pours start at +y and cut toward -y
frame_convention.T_to_M: (x, y)_M = (x, -y)_T ; solver field to T: c_M[::-1, :]
frame_convention.stage_positions: stage scripts give p0/p1 in the M frame (cup diameters)
